positive_results: Factor or acquire exact common roots for arbitrary acquired nonzero short signed labels, including first-drop recovery, in soft O(L+k).
Factor or certify unit-separated acquired root and row-clock nodes in soft O(L+k).
Explicit finite-alphabet inverse to N-powering after the existing scalar screen; no off-alphabet inverse.
Target-scale norm-one torus order-coprimality screen with unknown split orientation.
Complete-family common-unit skein correction acquired in soft O(L+sqrt(m)), with no extra physical zeros.
fallback: Shared-root collision predicates rebase exactly to common clock b^H and targets b^E_j, retaining the existing full-query bound and decoder.
clarifications: Finite-alphabet separation costs include the possible extractor as soft O(L+k).
First-drop extraction uses the previous projected clock q_D.
q_j^E_j=b^H, while the collision target is b.
Frobenius-deflated numerical unit acquisition is optional for zero/nonunit queries.
Actual opposite-row transport maps the apparent positive m+1 endpoint to legal negative -m.
Morton–Manchon Theorem 13 and Corollary 14 are in Section 7.
Rank-one algebraic recurrence is not a supplied initialized unique-step prefix algorithm.
